build_speech_to_speech_pipeline: build a SpeechToSpeechPipeline instance that loads a fairseq model from HuggingFace Hub for audio translation
run_audio_translation: run the SpeechToSpeechPipeline on a numpy audio waveform to get translated speech output
configure_tts_vocoder: configure the pipeline to use a CodeHiFiGAN unit vocoder or Griffin-Lim vocoder for TTS synthesis
review_pipeline_call_method: review the SpeechToSpeechPipeline call method that handles speech_to_text and speech_to_speech task routing
test_speech_to_speech_inference: test the pipeline by passing raw audio samples and verifying the returned waveform, sampling rate, and text annotations
